memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: You must not worship the Lord your God in their way. But you are to seek the place the Lord your God will choose from among all your tribes to put his Name there for his dwelling. To that place you must go; there bring your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and special gifts, what you have vowed to give and your freewill offerings, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks. - Deut 12:4-6 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God gives a striking command: "You must not worship the Lord your God in their way." Israel was not free to worship God however they pleased, borrowing the practices of the surrounding nations. Instead, God would choose the place and the manner of worship. This reveals something important: worship is not primarily about what we prefer or find meaningful, but about approaching God on the terms He sets. He is the one worshipped, and He defines how He is to be approached.

We live in an age that prizes self-expression, and we can easily bring that mindset into our relationship with God — worshipping in whatever way suits us, shaping God to fit our tastes. But true worship begins with humility, receiving how God has revealed Himself and coming to Him as He directs. It is not about crafting a spirituality we like; it is about honoring God as He is.

For Israel, God appointed one central place to put His Name and meet with His people. That whole system pointed forward to something greater. Under the new covenant, we no longer go to a temple in one location, because Jesus is the true meeting place between God and humanity. He said true worshipers would worship "in the Spirit and in truth" (John 4:23-24), and through Him we can draw near to God anywhere. We still come on God's terms, not our own — but now the way is a Person, Jesus, who opened access to the Father for all who trust Him. Come to God His way, through His Son.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do I approach worship on my own terms, or on God's?
- Have I ever tried to reshape God to fit my preferences?
- How does Jesus open the way for me to draw near to God?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, teach me to worship You on Your terms, not my own. Guard me from reshaping You to fit my tastes. Thank You that through Jesus I can draw near to You anywhere, worshiping in the Spirit and in truth. I come to You His way. Amen.
